screens.name: Turn-taking panel
screens.purpose: Make timing visible and tunable in milliseconds, with a predicted reply gap, Hinglish lexicons and presets, so a client can see why she waits and what a change costs.
screens.layout: Top: a waterfall bar of the predicted reply gap with a measured-p50 marker. Left: preset selector (Standard, Patient, Brisk) and ms sliders with ranges and one-line explanations. Centre: four editable lexicon lists per language. Right: silence ladder timeline and max call length. Bottom: a 'try it' strip that plays a simulated elderly caller with a 2.4 s pause and shows the result.

Slider: 'Hold when unsure 600 ms (0-2,000). Higher means fewer cut-ins on slow speakers and slower replies only when the turn sounds unfinished.'
Slider: 'Hold when unfinished 1,400 ms (0-3,000)' and 'Barge-in after 300 ms + 2 words'

comparison.their_best: Expressive mode, 10 audio-tag chips, stability and similarity, pronunciation dictionaries
comparison.vp_better_how: Voices chosen blind by ear with accent as its own axis and rating n shown; tone notes mapped to TTS styles and never spoken; sound tags only on voices that do not speak them; voice-language and gender mismatches refused. VP does not claim better raw voice than ElevenLabs.

comparison.dimension: Indian voice catalogue and number reading
comparison.their_best: 199 job-tagged voices, native-script glyphs, Indic number reading, mid-call language switch
comparison.vp_better_how: Per-voice number regression per locale with failing voices flagged; numbers only from data via predicate R6 with call-level slot memory; no companion or therapist voices in a business catalogue; retiring voices flagged.

comparison.best_competitor: Ultravox (demo); among India-hosted incumbents unmeasured at a handset
comparison.their_best: Clean-turn p50 1.54 s on its demo (n=52, US vantage)
comparison.vp_better_how: India media edge, region-pinned brain (304 ms first token), opening rendered during the ring, warm pools, speculative compute with release only through the turn manager, and a predicted gap shown before saving. Pass bar W3: p50 at least 0.3 s below the best incumbent, p90 2.5 s or less. Unproven: VP's lab ranges 0.8-4.2 s by stack.
comparison.evidence: [M] research/2026-10-17/lanes/l4b-measured/report.md; research/2026-10-17/lanes/l8-azure-bench/round2/findings.md (cascade A p50 1,004 ms, n=60); research/2026-10-20/teardown/SYNTHESIS.md W3

comparison.vp_better_how: Pause-aware release with a Hindi verb-final completeness cue, a fast path for one-token answers, a Patient preset, and withdraw-and-merge, aiming at 5% cut-ins or less at p50 1.2 s. ElevenLabs bought its 3% with a 3.75 s p50. VP today cuts in on 15-42%, so this is a target.

comparison.their_best: 11 'haan/hmm/ok' taken as acknowledgement; never 'are you still there?'
comparison.vp_better_how: Editable Hinglish acknowledgement, stop and answer lexicons on by default; every short final classified, never discarded; quiet-reply rescue for the 'hmm' ASR drops; context rule for 'theek hai'. Pass bar W4: 90%+ handled, stop within 600 ms.
comparison.evidence: [M] l4b round2 findings (Sarvam); [M] l4b (ElevenLabs 4/16 'are you still there'); [O] research/2026-10-20/account-phase/bolna/report.md s1.3 (short finals discarded); [M] docs/harvest/tx-voice.md (Voice Live stopped on 23/36 continuers)

comparison.their_best: Bolna: heard-text history, merge of unheard turns with 0.7 s settle, duplicate block, barge-in deferred during tools. Ultravox: 6/6 handled, stop in 0.32-0.59 s
comparison.vp_better_how: Adopts Bolna's recovery set plus a reference-AEC front end (Taxila: 0/66 echo false barge-ins, 12/12 true, stop p50 80 ms on its harness); stop words yield on one word; listens during the opening instead of dropping it.
comparison.evidence: [O] research/2026-10-20/account-phase/bolna/report.md s1.10, s5; [M] l4b report; [M] docs/harvest/tx-voice.md s6.2

comparison.their_best: Vapi: end-of-turn wait 0-3 s with ranges and start/stop plans. ElevenLabs: 1-2 sentence description and lock reasons under every setting
comparison.vp_better_how: Every timing in ms with ranges and an explanation, summed into a predicted reply gap beside the measured India p50, three named presets, Hindi lexicons, a try-it strip with an elderly caller.
comparison.evidence: [O] research/2026-10-21/walkthroughs/SYNTHESIS.md s3 (0 of 6 show a predicted gap or a Hindi list); decision.2026-10-21.wt-synthesis-turn-taking-panel
